title: “Parenting & Education in the Perasha: Ki Tesse” by Rabbi Richard Tobias

chapters.title: Introduction to Parenting and Parashat Ki Tesse
chapters.about: New series on parenting and education starting with Parashat Ki Tesse and the ben soror umoreh.

chapters.title: The Gamara on the Ben Soror Umoreh
chapters.about: Details of the 12-year-old boy, the consequences from parents, and the Beth din.

chapters.title: Theoretical Nature of the Mitzva
chapters.about: Criteria that make the mitzva theoretical and the redundancy in the Pasuk about parents.

chapters.title: Parents Must Sound and Look the Same
chapters.about: The Gamara's requirement that parents sound the same, look the same, and be the same height.

chapters.title: Parents Being on the Same Page
chapters.about: The message from the meforshim that mom and dad must be on the same page and avoid mixed messages.

summary: Rabbi Tobias discusses parenting and education based on Parashat Ki Tesse, focusing on the law of the ben soror umoreh in the Gamara. He explains how the requirement that the parents sound the same, look the same, and be the same height teaches that parents must be on the same page and give consistent messages to their children.
questions: What does Parashat Ki Tesse teach about raising children?
What does the Gamara say about the ben soror umoreh?
Why does the Pasuk mention the voice of the father and the voice of the mother?
What do the requirements of the parents' appearance and voice mean for education?
